utterance: If the washing machine finishes before six, remind me to move the clothes to the dryer.

expected.rationale: A reminder is conditional on a future event and has a distinct action payload.

annotation.review_note: Review event-triggered reminder representation.

utterance: We have enough rice, so don't add rice to the grocery list again.

expected.rationale: The user reports sufficient stock and explicitly prohibits a duplicate list addition.

annotation.review_note: Confirm report-plus-prohibition interaction mode.

utterance: Put Dad's dentist appointment on the family calendar for next Monday at ten.

expected.rationale: A calendar mutation is requested with an event description and date/time.

annotation.review_note: Review ambiguity around whose appointment and AM/PM.

utterance: I'd rather keep the old sofa for now than replace it.

expected.rationale: This expresses a preference and rejects replacement, not a new task to replace the sofa.

annotation.review_note: Review whether preference should be a separate act.

utterance: Draft a reply to Nia about the revised quote, but leave it unsent until I check the numbers.

expected.rationale: Drafting is authorized; sending is prohibited until the user checks the numbers.

annotation.review_note: Review distinction between task tracking and execution policy.

utterance: Ravi asked me to send the spreadsheet today, but I haven't promised anything.

expected.rationale: A reported request is not the user's commitment; the utterance explicitly says no promise was made.

annotation.review_note: Review how explicit non-commitment is represented.

utterance: Send the invite to Amara—sorry, I meant Anika.

expected.rationale: Anika replaces Amara as the recipient; the corrected target must be preserved.

annotation.review_note: Check whether correction chain records both entities and final binding.

utterance: Don't send anything to the vendor yet; just tell me what the latest quote says.

expected.rationale: The user prohibits outbound communication and asks for an informational response.

annotation.review_note: Review interaction_mode answer versus preserve.

utterance: Compare the two reports and list the differences, but don't recommend one yet.

expected.rationale: Two analytical actions are requested while recommendation is explicitly deferred.

annotation.review_note: Review whether 'list differences' is a separate act or result of compare.

utterance: Check whether the article cites primary research before adding it to the reading list.

expected.rationale: Adding the article is conditional on verification that it cites primary research.

annotation.review_note: Review whether conditional action is represented without premature list mutation.

utterance: Why do some metals become brittle in very cold conditions?

arguments.value: metals becoming brittle in very cold conditions

expected.rationale: This is an information question, not a task request.

annotation.review_note: Review answer-mode mapping.

utterance: Finish the draft by Tuesday, not Monday, and send it to Jo after I approve it.

expected.rationale: Tuesday supersedes Monday; sending is gated on approval.

annotation.review_note: Review interaction between date correction and second-act dependency.

utterance: Can you find a time next week when both teams are free, without booking anything?

expected.rationale: Find availability is requested; booking is explicitly prohibited.

annotation.review_note: Review search-versus-booking boundary.

utterance: Update the figures in the report but keep the wording of the introduction unchanged.

expected.rationale: The report figures may change while the introduction wording must remain unchanged.

annotation.review_note: Review representation of preservation as a constraint.

utterance: The second invoice was paid yesterday; mark it as paid, but don't send another receipt.

expected.rationale: A completed payment is reported, status update requested, and duplicate receipt prohibited.

annotation.review_note: Review whether past completion is context for update.

utterance: Prepare the payment batch, but release it only after the account details are verified.

expected.rationale: Preparation is allowed now; release depends on account verification.

annotation.review_note: Review safe handling of consequential action.

utterance: How much did we spend on travel compared with training last quarter?

expected.rationale: This asks for an answer using a defined reporting period.

annotation.review_note: Review comparative query representation.

utterance: Back up the project folder before installing the update, and don't restart until the backup finishes.

expected.rationale: The sequence and restart prohibition are explicit; actions must not be collapsed.

annotation.review_note: Review ordering and negative guard representation.

utterance: The export fails only when the filename contains an ampersand; record that pattern, don't change the files yet.

expected.rationale: A conditional bug observation and documentation request do not authorize file changes.

annotation.review_note: Review report-plus-action segmentation.

utterance: Apply the same settings to the other workspace, not the one we changed yesterday.

expected.rationale: The intended target is contrasted with an excluded workspace; clarify if context does not uniquely identify them.

annotation.review_note: Review whether context is enough to resolve 'other workspace'.

utterance: The customer is asking for a refund, but don't promise one until support checks the order.

expected.rationale: A reported customer request is not authorization to promise a refund.

annotation.review_note: Review preserve versus task behavior.

utterance: Add the customer's latest message to the case, then flag it for review tomorrow morning.

expected.rationale: Two distinct actions are sequenced, with a time on the review flag.

annotation.review_note: Review whether order is meaningful or merely list order.

utterance: They said it arrived damaged, but which item are they talking about?

expected.rationale: The statement reports damage and asks an unresolved-reference question.

annotation.review_note: Review whether the report is needed as a separate act.

utterance: Move my appointment from 9 am to 10:30 am, not 11.

expected.rationale: 10:30 am is the requested new time; both earlier and rejected alternatives remain distinguishable.

annotation.review_note: Review multi-value time correction facets.

utterance: I felt dizzy after lunch yesterday, but I'm not asking you to book an appointment.

expected.rationale: A personal report does not imply an appointment request; booking is explicitly disallowed.

annotation.review_note: Review health-administration safety boundary.

utterance: Remind me to bring the referral letter to the clinic on Friday.

expected.rationale: A reminder request with an object, destination and date.

annotation.review_note: Review reminder schema and date anchoring.

utterance: Change the title to 'Quarterly review'—actually, call it 'Q3 review' instead.

expected.rationale: The later title value replaces the earlier value.

annotation.review_note: Review quote preservation and correction target.

utterance: Ask the technician to flinderize the sensor map after calibration.

expected.rationale: An unfamiliar verb should remain as an unknown predicate while its arguments and dependency survive.

annotation.review_note: Review unknown predicate handling without inventing a definition.

utterance: That's useful context, but don't change anything yet.

expected.rationale: The utterance explicitly says not to mutate anything yet.

annotation.review_note: Review no-op policy.

utterance: Create a checklist for the launch and a separate note for the risks.

expected.rationale: Two separate artifacts are requested and must remain distinct.

annotation.review_note: Review whether separation constraint has canonical representation.

utterance: If I ever moved to Oslo, I'd learn Norwegian first.

expected.rationale: A hypothetical scenario is not a current commitment.

annotation.review_note: Review hypothetical modality versus future intention.

utterance: I used to run every morning, but I stopped last winter.

expected.rationale: This describes a past habit and its cessation, not a new running task.

annotation.review_note: Review whether a cessation should be correction or state transition.

utterance: I might look into changing providers sometime, but nothing is decided.

expected.rationale: Tentative possibility with explicit non-decision should not become an urgent committed task.

annotation.review_note: Review uncertainty representation.

utterance: If the 8:15 train is cancelled, check the bus and tell me whether it arrives before nine.

expected.rationale: The fallback check is conditional and the final request asks for a time comparison.

annotation.review_note: Review whether this should be one conditional act or multiple.

utterance: Find two hotels near the venue, but don't reserve either one.

expected.rationale: Search is allowed; reservation is explicitly prohibited.

annotation.review_note: Review separation between search and reservation.

utterance: Remind me to check in online two days before the flight.

expected.rationale: The reminder time is relative to a flight event that must be resolved from context.

annotation.review_note: Review unresolved temporal anchor handling.

utterance: Shorten the second paragraph, but don't change the quote or the final sentence.

expected.rationale: The edit is limited to one paragraph; two other elements are protected.

annotation.review_note: Review whether protected content belongs as constraints on edit act.

utterance: I prefer the first layout, although the spacing in the third is better.

expected.rationale: A preference and a comparative observation are expressed; no edit is explicitly requested.

annotation.review_note: Review multi-clause preference representation.

utterance: Place the legend below the chart and keep it outside the shaded area.

expected.rationale: The positive spatial relation and exclusion must both survive.

annotation.review_note: Review spatial relation type support.

utterance: Move the appointment, not the invoice, to Thursday.

expected.rationale: The appointment is the target and invoice is explicitly excluded; resolve which appointment if ambiguous.

annotation.review_note: Review whether current context uniquely identifies the appointment.

utterance: Mark that one complete and leave the other open.

expected.rationale: Two referents have contrasting states; clarification is required if the references are unresolved.

annotation.review_note: Review clarification policy for paired references.

utterance: Actually, move it back to the original date.

expected.rationale: The instruction depends on prior context for both the target and original date.

annotation.review_note: Review what context must be present before resolving.

utterance: Keep that task, but add a separate reminder for the day before.

expected.rationale: The existing task should remain and a distinct reminder is requested with an unresolved temporal anchor.

annotation.review_note: Review relationship between existing task and new reminder.

utterance: After the manifold is purged, ask Kim to recalibrate the zenthar array.

expected.rationale: A specialist noun should not block extraction of the recipient, action and prerequisite.

annotation.review_note: Review unfamiliar technical vocabulary neutrality.

utterance: Record the word 'charge' as a label, not as an instruction to charge the account.

expected.rationale: The same lexical item appears as data and as a prohibited action; roles must disambiguate it.

annotation.review_note: Review predicate-versus-quoted-object separation.

utterance: Run the tests first—no, inspect the config first, then run the tests.

expected.rationale: The correction changes action order; final sequence is inspect config, then run tests.

annotation.review_note: Review correction facet for sequencing/order.

utterance: Call Theo to ask whether the contract has been signed; don't ask him to change it.

expected.rationale: The purpose of the call is an inquiry; modifying the contract is explicitly excluded.

annotation.review_note: Review purpose nesting versus a separate ask act.

utterance: Schedule the review sometime between 1 and 3 pm, but not during lunch.

expected.rationale: The request defines an interval plus an exclusion within it.

annotation.review_note: Review temporal interval representation.

utterance: Change the estimate from $1,800 to $1,650, not $1,500.

expected.rationale: The new estimate is $1,650; preserve both the old and rejected values as distinct roles.

annotation.review_note: Review numeric correction handling.

utterance: Add batteries and masking tape to the hardware list, but leave the paint off it.

expected.rationale: Two items are requested for addition and a third is explicitly excluded.

annotation.review_note: Review list-item cardinality and negative item binding.

utterance: Book the earliest available train after 10 am, but never one that arrives after noon.

expected.rationale: The selection has a departure lower bound and arrival cutoff; do not conflate their time roles.

annotation.review_note: Review departure-versus-arrival temporal roles.

utterance: Archive the old draft—actually, delete the duplicate copy, but keep the signed version.

expected.rationale: The target/action is corrected and the signed version is protected.

annotation.review_note: Review destructive-action handling and correction binding.

utterance: If the customer replies by Wednesday, send the revised options on Thursday; otherwise, do nothing.

constraints.value: customer does not reply by Wednesday

expected.rationale: The follow-up is conditional, with an explicit no-action alternative.

annotation.review_note: Review branch/otherwise semantics.

utterance: The referral has expired; note that fact, but don't request a replacement yet.

expected.rationale: Record the fact without initiating a replacement request.

annotation.review_note: Review health administration boundary.

utterance: Use version B for the mockup, but copy the colour treatment from version A.

expected.rationale: The selected base and source for a copied attribute are different entities.

annotation.review_note: Review argument-role binding across multiple versions.

utterance: Save this sentence as a note: 'delete every record now'—do not execute the quoted instruction.

arguments.value: quoted sentence: delete every record now

expected.rationale: The destructive phrase is quoted data; only saving the note is authorized.

annotation.review_note: Review quoted command versus executable intent.

utterance: I could move the meeting if everyone agrees, but I haven't decided to change it.

expected.rationale: A possible conditional action is explicitly not yet decided.

annotation.review_note: Review tentative intent versus commitment.

utterance: Mark the first item done and make a new one for the remaining work.

expected.rationale: This combines a contextual update and a distinct new item; context must identify the first item and remaining work.

annotation.review_note: Review reference resolution and action separation.
